mapper.sql: GREATEST( p.capacity - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM program_application a WHERE a.program_id = p.id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED')), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS program_id, p.title AS title, p.description AS description, p.location_text AS location_text, p.spot_id AS spot_id, p.start_at AS start_at, p.end_at AS end_at, p.apply_open_at AS apply_open_at, p.apply_close_at AS apply_close_at, p.capacity AS capacity, AS remaining_seats, p.fee AS fee, p.payment_deadline_minutes AS payment_deadline_minutes, p.overnight AS overnight, p.status AS status FROM program p WHERE p.id = #{programId}

SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.status AS status, a.payment_due_at AS payment_due_at FROM program_application a WHERE a.program_id = #{programId} AND a.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM spot s WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE')
